articles.title: Quentin Murphy, 84, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Quentin Murphy for the many years of service to Kettle Hill.
body: Quentin Murphy died in July at home on Birch Terrace, at the age of 84. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Mill Hill Lions Club in his or her name.
Born in Kettle Hill in the years after the war, Quentin Murphy spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Kettle Hill.
